resources.string: Turtle WoW and Felsong, each a game of its own
Wrath of the Lich King and Felsong
The 3.3.5a game and its ChromieCraft realm
Not playable yet: its look, and its realm on the way
Felsong has its look here and nothing more yet. There\'s no Play: nothing here can start the game yet, and nothing of the other games changes.

Felsong\'s own server is closed, so its realm here will be LegionCore 7.3.5, the closest public Legion core, with Felsong\'s documented changes made on it and solo scaling. It\'s being made to run on the phone; it isn\'t in the app yet.

Legion\'s client (7.3.5, build 26972: your own) has to run on the phone through Wine and Box64, and Box64 doesn\'t run any WoW client from Legion on yet (box64 issue #3061). If Wow-64.exe reaches its login screen in Winlator 11.2 on your phone, the rest is worth building.
